ranked_weaknesses: Object interactions were staged near a zone rather than physically around the authoritative object or destination.
Every three-second heartbeat also resampled behavior and restarted presentation timing, making valid autonomy feel mechanically busy and fidgety.
Eight world minutes per three-second heartbeat produced a nine-real-minute day, so dawn/day/dusk/night read as a time-lapse instead of persistent environmental states.
Short pickup/place approaches shared a generic locomotion curve and could finish with a visible last nudge rather than a complete settle.
Shelf and activity-desk depth were mostly painted behind Moss, weakening surface ownership and occlusion.
Sleep travel could face opposite the actual movement direction; the promoted temporal auditor exposed this before acceptance.

character_pacing.rule: Canonical behavior decisions are separated from heartbeat/world advancement by deterministic multi-tick action commitments; continuation ticks preserve readable intent without creating a new decision.
character_pacing.renderer_rule: Visual interpolation remains presentation-only and faster than semantic commitment; incoming continuation frames do not restart the action clock.

pacing_scales.moment_to_moment: Canvas animation/interpolation at real RAF cadence; locomotion is approximately 1.5-2.3 seconds with contact, pose and settle changes over fractions of seconds to a few seconds.
pacing_scales.action: Canonical inspect/carry/place/window/rest/sleep intents persist across multiple three-second heartbeats, approximately 6-15 seconds depending on action.
pacing_scales.behavioral: Seed 1701 / 500 heartbeats produced 186 new decisions and 314 continuation ticks: about one new decision every 8.06 real seconds on average, with deterministic probabilistic autonomy preserved.
pacing_scales.environmental: World clock advances one world minute per three real seconds; weather blocks last about nine real minutes and the full day lasts 72 real minutes.

new.presentation: Renderer blends authoritative world_minutes through bounded environmental palette/daylight/night-glow transitions instead of a binary phase palette swap.

world_time.real_clock_sync: Deferred; repository evidence did not justify adding nondeterministic wall-clock authority.

promoted_auditor.name: simulation-behavior-auditor-r1
promoted_auditor.input_scope: 186 canonical decision events derived from the 500-heartbeat run; continuation ticks intentionally excluded from decision repetition metrics.

action_choreography.target_authority: Canonical frame/event metadata supplies target_object_id/target coordinates; the renderer owns no interaction target state.
action_choreography.inspect: Authoritative near-target stance, target-facing orientation, target-relative head/gaze/paw lean, readable hold and recovery.
action_choreography.pickup: Approach, reach/contact, transfer from surface, rigid paw/chest attachment, then locomotion.
action_choreography.carry: Stable rigid prop attachment with lower/steadier body posture and carried locomotion.
action_choreography.place: Stop/prepare, lower to authoritative destination, contact, release, object settle, retract/recovery.
action_choreography.window: Sill-side planted observation with sparse fidgeting and restrained environment response.
action_choreography.sleep_wake: Travel direction/facing agree; Moss settles into supported nook curl and unfolds deliberately on wake.

changes: Collection-shelf front lips now provide foreground occlusion for Moss and props.
Activity desk owns a foreground front edge so contact reads as a physical surface.
Existing blanket/nook overlap remains a supported sleep-depth cue.
No clutter was added merely to simulate detail; Moss remains the focal hierarchy.

promoted_auditor.name: temporal-render-auditor-r1
promoted_auditor.iteration_note: The first post-change audit correctly rejected short pickup/place settling at 0.104904 and sleep facing/settling; those defects were fixed and fresh evidence was recaptured before this accepted run.

subjective_hero_review.method: Human/visual inspection of the real 800x480 Canvas after the final temporal corrections; no automated beauty score.
conclusions: Target interactions read through approach, orientation, gaze, paw/body mechanics and contact rather than particles or text.
Placement reads stop -> lower/contact -> release -> settle; pickup and carry preserve visible prop ownership.
Sleep/wake remain supported by the nook and no longer read as a snap between upright and curled silhouettes.
Window watching stays quiet; activity-corner interaction reads against a physical surface rather than floating.
Shelf/desk foreground edges improve depth without hiding Moss, and accumulated history remains readable without clutter.
Dawn/dusk are recognizable intermediate environmental states without competing with Moss for attention.

objective_subjective_boundary: Automated temporal/behavior checks establish determinism, trajectory, facing, attachment, settling, continuity, RAF and sequence/distribution correctness. They do not judge charm, composition, warmth, personality or beauty; those remain real-Canvas visual-review judgments governed by ART_DIRECTION.md.

python_3_10_syntax.method: Python ast.parse with feature_version=(3,10); isolated Lab independently reports Python 3.10.12 available.

snapshot.selection_reason: All six objects have moved and seven persistent marks exist; Moss is inspecting a real shelf target during dusk, simultaneously demonstrating target staging, depth, accumulated history and slower environmental pacing.

sbc_conclusion.statement: No Gen18 warranted. Existing promoted behavior/temporal auditors, isolated Lab, mediated browser and project-safe lifecycle covered the iteration.
